title: Review of c15's nematic fuel-cell rods: SIBD replicates on 2 fresh seeds and the ring gates fuel, but a ring-free twin with fuel diffusion 6.7x slower everywhere divides exactly as much
summary: Re-ran world.py unchanged on fresh seeds 11 and 12 (128^2, T=1000): rods nucleate from noise, every body carries a closed s ring at its interface (95/95 and 85/85 bodies, rim/core 3.2-3.3, rim/outside 4.0-4.2 with c15's ringstat.py), and they divide by ring-pinching fission into ringed daughters (15 and 16 persistent splits, generation 3, merge/split 0.09-0.10). Gate controls on seed 11: beta=0 and chi_s=0 give core fuel 0.35 vs 0.58 and 9-10 persistent splits (also generation 3, 20 vs 25 final bodies), so the ring's effect on division is about 1.5x here, not 3x, and not one generation deeper. A ring-free twin with the fuel diffusivity lowered uniformly from 2.0 to 0.3 reproduces the world on seed 11 (15 persistent splits, generation 3, 25 final bodies, the same rod shapes; compare_s11.png); at 0.03 the bodies overdrive into chevrons. The linear (Laplacian-only) twin forms no bodies.

observations.S: rerun/seed11/sheet.png t=0 uniform noise, rods by t=135; same on rerun/seed12/sheet.png
observations.I: rerun/seed11/sheet.png: 20-27 discrete rods of bounded width from t=135 to 1000
observations.B: seed11_fission.png shell rows: closed s ring around every body, pinching into a figure-8 and leaving each daughter ringed; ringstat.txt 95/95 and 85/85 bodies membrane-like; chi_s=0 removes it (0/138)
observations.D: rerun/seed11/lineage.png: 15 persistent splits, generation 3 (yellow tracks born t~760); rerun/seed12: 16 persistent splits, generation 3

controls_run.B: controls/chis0_s11 (ring smeared, 0% membrane-like, core fuel 0.35) and controls/beta0_s11 (ring kept, no gating, core fuel 0.35): the ring is self-made, ablatable and gates fuel
controls_run.D: controls/beta0_s11 and controls/chis0_s11: 9 and 10 persistent splits, generation 3, vs 15 in rerun/seed11
controls_run.lowered-D twin: controls/slowD03_s11 (chi_s=0, Df=0.3 everywhere): 15 persistent splits, generation 3, 25 final bodies, rods as in the world; controls/slowD003_s11 (Df=0.03): 13 splits, misshapen chevron bodies, core fuel 1.08
controls_run.BD: controls/linear_s11: CH replaced by linear diffusion, 0 bodies

verdicts.limitation: The ring's work is real but small and not special: on seed 11 the ring-off arms still reach generation 3 with 9-10 splits (vs 15), and a ring-free world whose fuel simply diffuses 6.7x slower everywhere matches the ringed world split for split. So the ring acts as a slow-diffusion barrier, the same lesson as the FCH shells; it should not be scored as containment beyond diffusion (W). The Laplacian-only twin fails trivially (no phase separation) and tests neither the active stress nor the ring. Motility stays below 3 body lengths on both fresh seeds (2.2, 2.6), as the author says. No resolution check (1-2 px ring).
